verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents the Marketing Emails API, the email editor and workflows that run after an email is sent. Nothing shows an API for sending custom behavioral events from a product, or that such an event can enroll a specific contact in an automation. Post-send workflows are an adjacent feature, not event-triggered per-person automation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fire a custom event from my product and have it trigger an automation for exactly that person
